correctness.rationale: In characteristic two the sparse polynomial satisfies the polynomial identity P(X+1)+P(X)=P_prime(X)=1+X^(2^(r-2))+X^(2^(m-2)). This additive derivative has kernel {0,1}, since gcd(m,m-r)=1, and image 1+ker(field trace) of cardinality q/2. For D(x)=F(x+a)-F(x), Taylor modulo 4 gives D(x+2u)-D(x)=2u(F_prime(x+a)-F_prime(x))=0 because P_prime(t+1)=P_prime(t); similarly D(x+a)-D(x)=2(aF_prime(x)-D(x))=0 because P difference equals P_prime at residue level. Thus D is constant on each paired union of two residue classes of size 2q. Distinct pairs have different output residues, so exactly q/2 occupied cells with multiplicity 2q, for every coefficient lift including higher-degree terms. Independent exact GF2 polynomial expansion verified nine admissible (m,r) pairs through m=11; this is corroboration, not an infinite all-lifts proof.
